missions.title: Warm-Up Exercise
missions.description: M4A1's Report: The AR Team is infiltrating Area S09 to retrieve data left behind by a human named "Lyco" under Persica's commission.

missions.title: Dark Information
missions.description: M4A1's Report: The AR Team has located the data in Safe House 3, but fell into a trap laid by Sangvis Ringleader "Agent".

missions.title: Defend the Base
missions.description: M4A1's Report: We managed to stay until the data transfer was complete, but were chased into a blind alley before we could evacuate from the safe house.

missions.title: Final Challenge
missions.description: M4A1's Report: We were separated as we fled the battlefield with the assistance of a local Grifon squad, and were only reunited today…
